# Elmhurst Medical

> Elmhurst Medical is a primary care and walk-in urgent care clinic at 40-16 74th Street, Elmhurst, Queens, NY 11373. Phone (718) 682-7090. Care in English, Spanish, Bengali, Hindi and Urdu. Hours: Mon–Fri 10:00 AM–7:30 PM, Sat 2:30–7:30 PM, closed Sunday. Same-day appointments and walk-ins welcome; most major insurance accepted including Medicare and Medicaid, with clear self-pay pricing for uninsured patients.

Book: https://elmhurstmedical.com/booking (online via Zocdoc, phone, text, or WhatsApp at +1-718-682-7090).

## Core pages

- [Home](https://elmhurstmedical.com/): Clinic overview — primary care, urgent care, languages, insurance, booking.
- [Services](https://elmhurstmedical.com/services): Primary care, walk-in urgent care, mental health & psychiatry, diabetes and weight management, physicals (school, work, TLC/DOT), vaccines and on-site labs.
- [Our Team](https://elmhurstmedical.com/providers): Physicians and providers, languages spoken.
- [Book an Appointment](https://elmhurstmedical.com/booking): Book online on Zocdoc, by phone (718) 682-7090, by text, or WhatsApp; walk-in hours and what to bring.
- [Insurance & Pricing](https://elmhurstmedical.com/insurance): Accepted plans (Medicare, Medicaid, major commercial plans) and self-pay pricing.
- [Contact & Hours](https://elmhurstmedical.com/contact): Address, phone, hours, directions (74th St–Broadway / Jackson Heights station: 7, E, F, M, R).
- [Health Guides & Blog](https://elmhurstmedical.com/blog): Plain-language health guides in English, Spanish and Bengali.

## Facts

- Address: 40-16 74th Street, Elmhurst, NY 11373 (Queens, New York City)
- Phone: +1 (718) 682-7090 · WhatsApp: https://wa.me/17186827090 · Email: office@elmhurstmedical.com
- Online booking: https://www.zocdoc.com/practice/elmhurst-medical-68107
- Hours: Monday–Friday 10:00 AM–7:30 PM; Saturday 2:30 PM–7:30 PM; Sunday closed
- Languages: English, Spanish, Bengali, Hindi, Urdu
- Services: primary care, walk-in urgent care, mental health & psychiatry, diabetes & weight management (incl. GLP-1), physicals (school/work/TLC/DOT), vaccines, on-site labs
